scope: Selected National Pokedex species 001-151 imported from Pokemon Switch titles
ratingBasis: Engineering confidence from 0 to 100; these are assessed confidence values, not measured pixel-similarity percentages.

knownUnknowns.summary: Eevee's exact SSS variation 56 is selected and decompiled offline. Compiled option differentials exactly map base=tcb_8, normal=tcb_C, roughness=tcb_10, AO=tcb_14, and SSS mask=tcb_1A. Use-site data flow maps every named Eevee SSS material constant, the camera and dominant directional light, tcb_34 as mapped-normal diffuse irradiance, and tcb_36 as roughness-filtered reflection radiance. Mode 33 evaluates those cube roles through Phlosion's shared neutral environment with an explicit review/gameplay exposure bridge and restrained optional fibre sheen; bound source-scene values and the complete subsurface/light-transport equation remain incomplete.

Static disassembly proves Eevee's selected SSS program samples RoughnessMap as a scalar and has no dedicated fibre-direction texture. Phlosion's additional fibre relief/sheen is a visual reconstruction layered over the exact source atlases.

All four selected EyeClearCoat programs sample NormalMap1=tcb_1E, and all 486 current material instances enable it. Phlosion now bridges NormalMap1 with NormalHeight1 instead of the retained-but-not-directly-sampled NormalMap. The exact EnableHighlight variation 0/20 differential maps the directly used clear-coat base color, roughness and metallic plus highlight roughness, metallic, layer-5 emission color and intensity. Use-site tracing proves c8[96].xyz is an optional point-light position enabled by positive W, with the dominant directional light as fallback. Its bound value, light color/intensity, the projected scalar, shadow arrays, environment, packed legacy maps, and complete equation order remain incomplete.

Tentacool and Tentacruel's four FresnelEffect materials resolve exactly to retained variation 0 (shader 0x59, global 0x0). Compiled use-site data flow maps the five 2D material textures, local specular probe, diffuse irradiance cube, directly used constants, and fifth-power Fresnel alpha equation. Native mode 34 bridges the exact authored controls across all three APIs, losslessly transports the authored RGBA16F six-face LocalSpecularProbe, and samples its base mip directly. Anonymous scene/BRDF factors and final source-framebuffer parity remain incomplete.
Local reflection probes, exposure, tone mapping, additional lights and final color processing are not yet reproduced from a source GPU capture.
Thin transparent eye and accessory surfaces do not have the source scene-color refraction path.
Some Eye normals appear to be projected optical inputs rather than portable tangent-space detail normals.
Opaque pupil/iris shells are depth-separated in Phlosion because the source optical compositing pass is not implemented directly.
Transparent compound-eye lenses currently use a fixed dielectric coverage rather than source scene-color refraction.
Light-table textures and native parameters are retained, but the character shader lookup and combination rules are not implemented exactly.
Sphere-map, specular, deep-shadow and rim terms are preserved in native metadata but only partially represented by the portable runtime material.
The environment CaptureLab precedent exists, but representative Pokemon character draws have not yet been captured and decoded.
Object-space normal maps are preserved as evidence but are not bound to Phlosion's tangent-space runtime normal slot.
The incomplete PokeDefaultShader light-table translation can make models pale and erase material separation; the rejected Pinsir replacement is the regression case.
Sphere-map, deep-shadow, rim, specular and packed ambient semantics need a captured character-shader implementation.

The confidence denominator is now the full 65-species, 212-output, 1,084-material browser corpus across Eye, FresnelEffect, IkCharacter, NonDirectional, and Unlit. All 20 selected permutations and 11 programs resolve exactly through 183 one-option edges, but the deeply qualified material-local runtime proof still covers the 52-model IkCharacter/Eye/FresnelEffect subset. The former 97 whole-source score incorrectly conflated those scopes; 97 now applies only to qualified IkCharacter and eye material-local math.

All four selected IkCharacter programs, all output-reachable resources, and their complete one-option graph are exact. Variations 514 and 594 share a byte-identical fragment program. The ordinary-body map covers 62 named fields and proves the ShadowingBias polynomial, half-Lambert band, front/back rim domains, middle/dark hue targets and ordered cross-blend, local diffusion scale, direct-specular material path, and metallic reflection gate. Eye variations 682/1214 retain those local motifs; their ten-field map proves the static eyelid-then-highlight order for both base and shadow color, and compiled loop analysis now proves their complete view-dependent refraction and height march. All 184 cooked mode-32 records preserve 14 authored native scalar lanes plus neutral runtime-only lanes and their verified emission, including regular/shiny Staryu's achromatic 0.5 layer-3 term. The scene pass now also resolves fp_c4[0] as the dominant light vector, the indexed direct-radiance and diffuse-environment records, both inverse-pi RGB chains, and the distinct diffuse/local-reflection cube directions; bound scene values and the complete scene-dependent BRDF remain unavailable or reconstructed.

All authored texture roles and semantic controls are retained. Compiled operation signatures distinguish layer-mask scaling from emission-layer intensity and prove the ShadowingBias, half-Lambert, back-rim, diffusion, and ordered color-process blocks. All seven forward programs share one projected 2D mask plus a 16-tap cascaded depth/tag filter, use -fp_c4[0].xyz as the dominant fragment-to-light direction, and sample diffuse irradiance at LOD 0 with shading-normal Z flipped. IkCharacter selects fp_c4[1+lightIndex].rgb/pi for direct radiance and multiplies its diffuse cube by (1-metallic), fp_c4[41].rgb, fp_c3[28].x, fp_c4[26].rgb, fp_c4[27+lightIndex].rgb, and 1/pi. It separately clamps combined visibility plus the squared anonymous fp_c7[97].w shadow-bypass scalar, then drives middle/dark processing with max direct-diffuse RGB. All 226 selected forward materials declaring ReceiveShadow request it enabled. All three APIs use exact normalized unit-white staging and keep unavailable bound scene payloads neutral. Raw rim values retain sRGB compensation and the unresolved 0.25 scene-exposure calibration remains presentation-side.

Mode 35 evaluates all effect-bearing retained inputs for 80 IkCharacter eye materials on OpenGL, D3D12, and Vulkan: 70 nonzero parallax heights, four non-unit IORs, 48 eyelid-shadow masks, 24 nonzero highlights, 68 specular materials, AO, and authored local reflection. Compiled operation and output-reachability proofs establish the exact material-local eyelid-then-highlight order for both base and shadow color. They also prove the refraction basis, normalized derivative footprint, fifth-power view fade, 2-to-12 depth schedule, 4-to-14 sample march, native hit test, and two-sample refinement now shared by all three backends. The remaining 160 colored-shadow bindings are source-neutral for this selected eye corpus. Anonymous scene terms and visual framebuffer parity remain open.

The expanded report verifies 212 outputs and 1,032 material bindings; 210 models bind one exact authored BC6H cube and two do not. Every face/mip half-float RGB sample is measured, with mip-5 mean linear luminance 0.006268767. Compiled data flow proves the ordered layer-resolved Metallic value gates the local-reflection branch, ReflectionsBlur is its literal LOD, and HueShiftBias floors its shaped channels. All three backends pin reflect(-view, mappedNormal); the separate LOD-0 diffuse-irradiance branch uses an explicit measured 32x offline exposure bridge because its scene-owned cube and exposure are absent.

Every selected IkCharacter material disables the source EnableHairSpecular branch, and the selected programs do not bind HairSpecularMap. Mode 32 therefore no longer injects a species-classified fibre/feather sheen or an SV roughness graft. Visible soft-surface relief comes from the selected program's real base, normal, shadow, specular, and rim inputs; their complete lighting equation is still part of the broader IkCharacter BRDF gap.

FresnelEffect variation 0 now has exact sampler mappings, fifth-power alpha, roughness-driven probe LOD, probe intensity, and lossless regular/shiny local probes; complete refraction/scene composition remains open.

Direct header inspection proves null reflection pointers for all four selected IkCharacter programs. Cross-family compiled analysis nevertheless classifies fp_c5[19].xyz as camera world position and fp_c4[0].xyz as the dominant light vector, proves the shared fp_c10[12] final scene fade in seven forward material programs, and proves the source tone-map order through exposure, a log-encoded 3D LUT, sRGB transfer, and final color matrix. It also resolves the indexed fp_c4 direct/diffuse-environment record layout, the diffuse-irradiance cube direction, the local-reflection direction, the shared projected-mask/cascaded-shadow sampling shape, and IkCharacter's shadowed-N.L plus max-direct-RGB insertion points. Three ReceiveShadow option edges compile identically, confirming shared scene/draw state, while the complete selected census proves all 226 declaring forward materials request it enabled. Bound shadow payloads and transforms, actual scene-light and irradiance values, exposure, LUT payload, color-matrix values, and final framebuffer state remain unavailable from the loose assets.
Clip curves and visibility are preserved strongly, while controller selection, event semantics and action-role meaning still require case-specific qualification.
